_doc: Manifest of environment variables this app uses. The build-time check (scripts/check-required-env.mjs) fails if any 'required' key is missing in process.env, and warns if any 'optional' key is missing. Keep this list in sync with src/ usage when adding/removing env-dependent features.

required.name: DATABASE_URL
required.purpose: Postgres pooled (PgBouncer) connection — runtime queries

required.name: DIRECT_URL
required.purpose: Postgres direct/session connection — Prisma migrate diff + schema-drift check

required.name: NEXTAUTH_SECRET
required.purpose: NextAuth JWT signing key

required.name: NEXTAUTH_URL
required.purpose: Canonical base URL used by NextAuth callbacks

required.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_PLATFORM_DOMAIN
required.purpose: Root platform domain (e.g. authorloft.com) — used for subdomain routing + link generation

required.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
required.purpose: Google OAuth client ID — Google sign-in

required.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
required.purpose: Google OAuth client secret — Google sign-in

required.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
required.purpose: Stripe server-side key — checkout + subscriptions

required.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
required.purpose: Stripe webhook signing secret — /api/stripe/webhook

required.name: STRIPE_STANDARD_PRICE_ID
required.purpose: Stripe price ID for the Standard plan

required.name: STRIPE_PREMIUM_PRICE_ID
required.purpose: Stripe price ID for the Premium plan

required.name: RESEND_API_KEY
required.purpose: Resend API key — all transactional + broadcast email

required.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
required.purpose: Supabase project URL — storage uploads

required.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
required.purpose: Supabase service-role key — storage uploads (bypasses RLS)

required.name: AWS_REGION
required.purpose: S3 region (large-file uploads)

required.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
required.purpose: S3 credentials

required.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
required.purpose: S3 credentials

required.name: AWS_S3_BUCKET
required.purpose: S3 bucket name

required.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
required.purpose: AES key for encrypting author-provided API keys at rest

required.name: REDIS_URL
required.purpose: Redis (Vercel KV) URL — rate limiting + idempotency

required.name: CRON_SECRET
required.purpose: Vercel-supplied cron auth — required by every /api/cron/* route. Missing this silently 401s all crons (seen in prod Jun 2026)

required.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
required.purpose: Google Gemini API key — AI assist features

required.name: SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL
required.purpose: Where contact-form / admin escalations are delivered

optional.name: SMTP_FROM
optional.purpose: Override default 'from' address on outbound email

optional.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS_ID
optional.purpose: Google Ads tag — analytics-only, degrades gracefully

optional.name: PLATFORM_FEE_PERCENT
optional.purpose: Override default Stripe Connect platform fee %

optional.name: POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY
optional.purpose: PostHog server-side API key — analytics queries

optional.name: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
optional.purpose: Sentry auth token — source map upload at build time

optional.name: SOCIAL_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY
optional.purpose: Encryption key for stored social OAuth tokens (only needed once Social Promote phase 2 ships)

optional.name: SOCIAL_PROMOTE_ADMIN_EMAILS
optional.purpose: Comma-separated admins to notify on Social Promote abuse alerts

optional.name: SOCIAL_PROMOTE_KILL_SWITCH
optional.purpose: Set to '1' to globally disable Social Promote generation

optional.name: VERCEL_API_TOKEN
optional.purpose: Vercel API token — self-serve custom domain linking (Admin > Settings). Without it, linking a domain fails cleanly with an error; nothing else degrades.

optional.name: VERCEL_PROJECT_ID
optional.purpose: Vercel project ID that custom domains get registered against

optional.name: VERCEL_TEAM_ID
optional.purpose: Vercel team ID, only needed if the project lives under a team scope

optional.name: RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET
optional.purpose: Resend webhook signing secret (starts 'whsec_') for /api/webhooks/resend — powers newsletter open/click analytics. Also requires Open+Click Tracking enabled on the sending domain and a webhook subscribed to email.opened/email.clicked in the Resend dashboard. Without it, sending still works, opens/clicks just aren't recorded.
